episodes.title: Strange New Worlds
episodes.summary: When one of Pike's officers goes missing while on a secret mission for Starfleet, Pike has to come out of self-imposed exile. He must navigate how to rescue his officer, while struggling with what to do with the vision of the future he's been given.

episodes.title: Children of the Comet
episodes.summary: While on a survey mission, the U.S.S. Enterprise discovers a comet is going to strike an inhabited planet. They try to re-route the comet, only to find that an ancient alien relic buried on the comet's icy surface is somehow stopping them. As the away team try to unlock the relic's secrets, Pike and Number One deal with a group of zealots who want to prevent the U.S.S. Enterprise from interfering.

episodes.title: Ghost of Illyria
episodes.summary: The U.S.S. Enterprise encounters a contagion that ravages the ship. One by one, the entire crew is incapacitated except for Number One, Una Chin-Riley, who must now confront a secret she's been hiding as she races to find a cure.

episodes.title: Memento Mori
episodes.summary: While on a routine supply mission to a colony planet, the U.S.S. Enterprise comes under an attack from an unknown malevolent force. Pike brings all his heart and experience to bear in facing the crisis, but the security officer warns him that the enemy cannot be dealt with by conventional Starfleet means.

episodes.title: Spock Amok
episodes.summary: It's a comedy of manners when Spock has a personal visit in the middle of Spock and Captain Pike's crucial negotiations with an unusual alien species.

episodes.title: Lift Us Where Suffering Cannot Reach
episodes.summary: A threat to an idyllic planet reunites Captain Pike with the lost love of his life. To protect her and a scientific holy child from a conspiracy, Pike offers his help and is forced to face unresolved feelings of his past.

episodes.title: The Serene Squall
episodes.summary: While on a dangerous humanitarian mission, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise stumbles into a harrowing game of leverage with the quadrant's deadliest space pirate

episodes.title: The Elysian Kingdom
episodes.summary: The U.S.S. Enterprise becomes stuck in a nebula that is home to an alien consciousness that traps the crew in a fairy tale.

episodes.title: All Those Who Wander
episodes.summary: The U.S.S. Enterprise crew comes face-to-face with their demons – and scary monsters too – when their landing party is stranded on a barren planet with a ravenous enemy.

episodes.title: A Quality of Mercy
episodes.summary: Just as Captain Pike thinks he's figured out how to escape his fate, he's visited by his future self, who shows him the consequences of his actions.

episodes.title: The Broken Circle
episodes.summary: A distress call from Lt. Noonien-Singh compels Spock to disobey orders and take the U.S.S. Enterprise and its crew into disputed space, risking renewed hostilities with the Klingons in a bid to aid their shipmate.

episodes.title: Ad Astra Per Aspera
episodes.summary: Commander Una faces court-martial along with possible imprisonment and dishonorable dismissal from Starfleet, and her defense is in the hands of a lawyer who's also a childhood friend with whom she had a terrible falling out.

episodes.title: Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow
episodes.summary: La'An travels back in time to the 21st century Earth to prevent a attack which will alter humanity's future history.

episodes.title: Among the Lotus Eaters
episodes.summary: Returning to a planet that dredges up tragic memories, Captain Pike and his landing party find themselves forgetting everything, including their own identities as he confronts a ghost from his past.

episodes.title: Charades
episodes.summary: A shuttle accident leads to Spock's Vulcan DNA being removed by aliens, making him fully human and completely unprepared to face T'Pring's family.

episodes.title: Lost in Translation
episodes.summary: Uhura seems to be the only one who can hear a strange sound. When the noise triggers terrifying hallucinations, she enlists an unlikely assistant to help her track down the source.

episodes.title: Those Old Scientists
episodes.summary: An accident while investigating a time portal sends Ensigns Beckett Mariner and Bradward Boimler through time from the 24th Century, and Captain Pike and his crew must get them back where they belong before they can alter the timeline.

episodes.title: Under the Cloak of War
episodes.summary: Captain Pike and his crew welcome a Klingon defector aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, but his presence triggers the revelation of some shocking secrets.

episodes.title: Subspace Rhapsody
episodes.summary: An accident with an experimental quantum probability field causes everyone on the U.S.S. Enterprise to break uncontrollably into song, but the real danger is that the field is expanding and beginning to impact other ships — allies and enemies alike.

episodes.title: Hegemony
episodes.summary: When the U.S.S. Enterprise investigates an attack on a colony at the edge of Federation space, Captain Pike and his crew face the return of a formidable enemy.

episodes.title: Hegemony, Part II
episodes.summary: Pike leads a risky rescue behind enemy lines as the landing party flees a deadly enemy.

episodes.title: Wedding Bell Blues
episodes.summary: At a Federation celebration, an uninvited guest disrupts Spock and the crew's reflections.

episodes.title: Shuttle to Kenfori
episodes.summary: Pike and M'Benga enter disputed Klingon space to find a cure for Batel, as M'Benga's past resurfaces on a planet swarming with deadly creatures.

episodes.title: A Space Adventure Hour
episodes.summary: When La'An tests a prototype holodeck with a fictional case only she can solve, the consequences of failure get greater and greater, with the Enterprise hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Through the Lens of Time
episodes.summary: Chapel and Korby's quest to uncover the next step in human evolution leads the Enterprise to a planet where ancient ruins hide a deeper mystery and a terrifying secret.

episodes.title: The Sehlat Who Ate Its Tail
episodes.summary: Lieutenant Commander James Kirk's first day in the Captain's chair of the U.S.S. Farragut takes a disastrous turn when the Enterprise is captured by a deadly Scavenger Ship. But the alien menace is not exactly what it seems…

episodes.title: What Is Starfleet?
episodes.summary: The Enterprise escorts cargo to help a war-ravaged planet, but controversial truths about it cause Pike and the crew to come under the scrutiny of an investigative journalist.

episodes.title: Four-and-a-Half Vulcans
episodes.summary: After the Enterprise completes a mission requiring several of the crew to become Vulcan, new problems arise when it is time for them to change back into humans.

episodes.title: Terrarium
episodes.summary: When Ortegas crash lands on a deadly toxic moon, where the chances of survival are slim to none, she finds herself stranded and forced to challenge her most closely held beliefs in order to survive.

episodes.title: New Life and New Civilizations
episodes.summary: When an ancient, evil alien force re-emerges, Pike must make one of the hardest decisions of his life to stop the evil from spreading.

episodes.title: Valles Marineris
episodes.summary: Pike leads the crew into a stellar storm, sending the Enterprise back 65 million years.

episodes.title: The Griffin Incident
episodes.summary: La'An, Spock, and Kirk get trapped on a mysterious, long-lost Federation ship.

episodes.title: Human Best Friend
episodes.summary: Shore leave on a pleasure planet turns dangerous when the crew's promised escape stops behaving like fun.

episodes.title: A Case of Chiaroscuro
episodes.summary: Una is mistaken for a virtuous kingpin against a Klingon occupation.

episodes.title: Level-Five Transporter Accident
episodes.summary: A transporter accident turns everyone but Spock into puppets as pirates invade the ship.

episodes.title: Off-Hour
episodes.summary: The Enterprise falls into a slipstream that pushes them to a catastrophic warp threshold.

episodes.title: Like Chronitons Through the Hourglass
episodes.summary: A space trickster traps the Enterprise crew in a soap opera as Pike mourns a lost life.

episodes.title: Orders of Magnitude
episodes.summary: Enterprise is commandeered by Admiral Reeger to track down an alien ship.

episodes.title: Once La'An a Time
episodes.summary: We return to the Elysian Kingdom, but this time on a REAL fantasy planet.

episodes.title: Tomorrow's Enterprise
episodes.summary: A time ripple damages the Enterprise, forcing young and old Uhura to cooperate and fix the timeline.
